title: Which of these repos document a WebSocket API, and where?
question: For each of cloudflare/agents, e2b-dev/E2B, modelcontextprotocol/servers and nodejs/undici, say whether its documentation mentions a WebSocket API, and quote one line of evidence.
why: The honest shape of a research question. Four repos, one small answer. The classic arm cannot hold even one of these payloads, let alone four.

expect.note: Deterministic substring grading. A model grading a model would put the thing under test inside the measurement. These strings were chosen from what the servers actually returned on 2026-09-21, so a server change makes the grade fail loudly rather than drift quietly.
